dedupe_keys.name: census of governments government units listing and annual government organization counts special districts by function

description: The organization component of the U.S. Census Bureau's Census of Governments lists every unit of state and local government in the United States and counts them by type each year. The 2022 Government Units Listing is a public spreadsheet of the 90,887 governments enumerated in 2022, with sheets for general-purpose governments (counties, municipalities, townships), school districts and 39,555 special district governments. Each special district row gives the Census government id, name, function code, mailing address, website, state and county FIPS codes. Function codes identify infrastructure operators that appear in no asset register: 3,550 water supply utilities, 1,829 sewerage and 1,380 combined sewerage and water districts, 2,419 drainage and 599 flood control districts, 955 irrigation, 1,149 highway, 435 air transportation, 367 public mass transit, 173 electric power, 65 gas supply and 138 sea and inland port districts, plus 5,957 fire protection districts. Coverage: census years ending in 2 and 7 since 1957, annual counts (2025 and 2026 released), and a Census Data API series from 1942 to 2026. Access: ZIP of XLSX with documentation on www2.census.gov, tables on census.gov, and the govsorg API (free key); free and public domain. Caveats: mailing addresses, not service areas or coordinates; the Government Units Survey that fed the listing was discontinued in April 2025, last completed in 2021. Simulation uses: identifying which public body runs local water, drainage, power or transit service, and joining operators to finance and employment records. Related records: State and Local Government Finances, the public employment survey, EPA SDWIS and the FTA National Transit Database.
